Frequently Asked Questions (LLM Token & Cost Calc)

How are BPE tokens estimated from English and code text?

Modern tokenizers (cl100k_base / o200k_base) average ~3.8 to 4.0 characters per token for English prose and ~3.1 characters per token for punctuation-dense JSON and source code.
